第75章 升职-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

一九七一年的北京，一月的风还带着西伯利亚的寒劲，王建新从老首长那里回来之后，日子又恢复了原来的节奏——出操、上课、做实验、写思想汇报，一样不落。只是来找他看病的人更多了，学校的、校外的、从外地专程赶来的，诊室门口经常排着队。

他没想到的是，更大的事在后面。

年终总结评定的时候，部队正式下文嘉奖。他给老首长治病的全过程，从周副团长引荐到治疗经过到痊愈复查，被一层一层地报了上去——卫生院的病例记录、保健医生的观察报告、会诊专家的签字确认、老首长痊愈后的体检结果，一沓厚厚的材料，经过军委卫生系统和军区党委的联合审批，最终结论是：王建新同志在救治高级首长过程中，政治立场坚定，医疗技术精湛，功绩突出，影响重大，符合《中国人民解放军战时立功条例》相关规定，记个人二等功一次。

二等功，这个分量王建新知道。在和平年代，一等功是拿命换的，二等功是拿本事换的。他在边防团立一等功，那是跟越境分子真刀真枪干出来的。这次立二等功，是他用针灸和中药，把京城各大医院都束手无策的老首长治好了。两种功，一个战场，一个病房，但分量都不轻。

消息传到北医，教导员第一时间找到王建新，把一份红头文件递给他。“你自己看。”教导员说，脸上的表情很复杂，有高兴，也有一种说不出的感慨。

王建新翻开文件，从头到尾看了一遍。内容不长，但每一句都沉甸甸的：

根据王建新同志在校求学期间的突出表现——攻克全军各大医院束手无策的疑难顽疾，挽救了高级首长的生命，政治影响重大，医疗功绩突出，经军委卫生系统、军区党委联合审批，破格核定如下：

第一，行政级别直接定为二十一级。1965年“减薪定级”之后，军队干部级别统一改定为国家行政干部级别，共设二十三级。

第二，职务定为正连职军医。连级是“官”的起点，管一个连队，管几十号人，放在基层部队已经是一方小主了。

第三，待遇高配——正连职务，享受正营级的工资、住房、医疗、后勤全套待遇。正营级在部队里已经是“营座”了，家属可以随军，住房有单独的公寓，医疗保健级别也更高。而王建新还没毕业，连正式分配都没到，就已经提前享受了。

文件最后还附了几条说明。王建新看了，心里有了数。工农兵学员在读期间立功，级别和待遇当场生效，不用等毕业。二等功档案永久归档，过往所有战功全部累计叠加，后续晋职、晋级、调级一路绿灯。在读即可享受高一级待遇，军龄连续计算，毕业分配直接进军区核心卫勤单位，跳过基层磨练。

In Beijing in 1971, the January wind still carried the chill of Siberia. After Wang Jianxin came back from the old leader, life returned to its original rhythm - going to exercises, attending classes, doing experiments, and writing ideological reports, all the same.It's just that more people come to him for treatment, from school, from outside the school, and from other places. There is often a queue at the door of the clinic.

What he didn't expect was that bigger things were coming.

During the year-end review and evaluation, the troops will be formally rewarded.The whole process of his treatment for the old chief, from the introduction by Deputy Commander Zhou to the treatment process and the review of recovery, was reported layer by layer - the case records of the health center, the observation report of the health doctor, the signature confirmation of the consulting expert, the physical examination results of the old chief after his recovery, a thick stack of materials, afterThe final conclusion of the joint review and approval by the Military Commission's health system and the military region's party committee was that in the process of treating senior leaders, Comrade Wang Jianxin had a firm political stance, superb medical skills, outstanding achievements, and significant influence, which complied with the relevant provisions of the "Regulations on Meritorious Service in Wartime of the Chinese People's Liberation Army" and was recorded as a second-class personal merit.

Second-class merit, Wang Jianxin knew this weight.In peacetime, first-class merit is exchanged for life, and second-class merit is exchanged for ability.He achieved first-class meritorious service in the border defense regiment, which was achieved by fighting with real swords and guns against border crossers.This time he achieved second-class merit because he used acupuncture and traditional Chinese medicine to cure the old chief who was helpless in major hospitals in the capital.Two kinds of skills, one battlefield and one ward, but they are not light in weight.

When the news reached Beijing Medical University, the instructor immediately found Wang Jianxin and handed him a red-headed document."See for yourself." The instructor said, with complex expressions on his face, ranging from happiness to unspeakable emotion.

Wang Jianxin opened the document and read it from beginning to end.The content is not long, but every sentence is heavy:

Based on Comrade Wang Jianxin's outstanding performance during his studies at the school - overcoming difficult and stubborn diseases that major hospitals in the army were unable to deal with, saving the lives of senior leaders, having great political influence, and outstanding medical achievements, after joint review and approval by the Health System of the Military Commission and the Party Committee of the Military Region, the exception was approved as follows:

First, the administrative level is directly set at Level 21.After the "salary reduction and grading" in 1965, the military cadre levels were uniformly changed to the national administrative cadre level, with a total of 23 levels.

Second, the position is set as a full-time military doctor.The company level is the starting point of "official". In charge of a company and dozens of people, if you are placed in the grassroots army, you are already a small leader.

Third, high remuneration - holding a full company position and enjoying full battalion-level wages, housing, medical care, and logistics benefits.The main battalion level is already a "camp seat" in the army. Family members can accompany the army, have separate apartments for housing, and have higher levels of medical care.And Wang Jianxin has not graduated yet, and has already enjoyed it in advance before he has even been officially assigned.

The document also includes a few notes at the end.Wang Jianxin read it and had an idea.If worker, peasant, and soldier students perform meritorious service during their studies, their grades and benefits will take effect on the spot without waiting for graduation.Second-class merit files are permanently archived, and all past military merits are accumulated and accumulated, and subsequent promotions, promotions, and upgrades are given the green light.You can enjoy a higher level of treatment while studying, and your military service life will be calculated continuously. After graduation, you will be assigned directly to the core medical service unit of the military area, skipping the grassroots training.
